## Question 1

Write a function that performs the calculation $p = 3j^3 + 6kj + k^4 + 3$. Include an example call to demonstrate your function's operation.

```{r}
calc_it <- function(j, k) 3*j^3 + 6*k*j + k^4 + 3
calc_it(3,4)
```

\vspace{5cm}

## Question 2

Create a repeat loop that prints out all even numbers up to and including 100. (Hint: `%%` will give you the remainder after division.)

```{r}
x <- 0
repeat{
  x <- x + 1
  if(x %% 2 == 0) print(x)
  if(x == 100) break
}

```

## Question 3

Rewrite the answer for Question 2 using a while loop. 

```{r}
x <- 0
while(x < 101){
  x <- x + 1
  if(x %% 2 == 0) print(x)
}

```

## Question 4

Use the iris data set, write a conditional that creates a new column in the data set named `species_numbers` and records the following numbers for each species: 10 for "setosa", 30 for "versicolor", and 55 for "virginica".

```{r}
data(iris)

iris$species_numbers <- ifelse(iris$Species == "setosa", 10,
                               ifelse(iris$Species == "versicolor",
                                      30, 55))
  
```

\vspace{5cm}


## Question 5

Rewrite the answer for Question 4 using a loop and a traditional conditional.

```{r}

iris$species_numbers <- NA

for(i in 1:nrow(iris)) { 
  if(iris$Species[i] == "setosa"){
    iris$species_numbers[i] <- 10
  }else if (iris$Species[i] == "versicolor"){
    iris$species_numbers[i] <- 30
  }else{
    iris$species_numbers[i] <- 55
  }
}
```
